howToPlay: Byron is a support brawler who uses long-range darts to heal allies or damage enemies over time. Use his Super to impact multiple targets with a splash effect, and utilize his gadgets to manage his personal health or output burst healing and damage.
gears: Equip DAMAGE to increase offensive output when low on health, and SHIELD to bolster his survival. GADGET COOLDOWN is also useful for keeping his utility active during long matches.
trait: This brawler suits players who prefer a calculated playstyle focused on balancing healing support with precision damage.
